turns.q: Tell me about the last time an alarm was unclear.
turns.a: I get a colleague to verify what the alert means before continuing.

turns.q: How do you learn a new pump?
turns.a: Usually somebody walks us through it briefly around shift change.

turns.q: What do you check before starting?
turns.a: I verify the medication amount before initiating delivery.

turns.q: What happens when setup takes too long?
turns.a: I put a visible note where I will see it again.

turns.q: Do you use a named analytics platform?
turns.a: That is outside what I work with, so I cannot name one.

turns.q: Would you always follow every optional screen?
turns.a: No. Immediate care can take priority over optional prompts.
